title: Purair® RX Ductless Balance Enclosures
meta_title: Purair RX Ductless Balance Enclosures - Air Science
meta_description: The Purair® RX Balance Hood is a Class I enclosure that meets USP 800 requirements for non-sterile compounding procedures.
meta_keywords: purair rx, ductless balance enclosures, balance enclosures, compounding, powder mixing, powder weighing
short_description: The Purair® RX Balance Hood is a Class I enclosure that meets USP 800 requirements for non-sterile compounding procedures.
full_description: Using innovative filtration technology, the Purair RX creates a safe work environment over the widest range of applications in the industry. Features include a high efficiency ebm-papst EC blower, energy savings LED lighting, and protection from powder and particle hazards. The improved filter clamping eliminates bypass leakage, and the exhaust canopy allows for thimble ducting to the facility exhaust system. The Purair RX also includes a filter blockage alarm and complies with USP 800 and USP 795 guidelines.
seo_content: The Purair RX ductless balance enclosures are designed for a variety of laboratory and industrial applications, including balance enclosures, compounding, powder mixing, and powder weighing. These Class I enclosures utilize advanced filtration technology to provide a safe and controlled work environment that meets stringent USP 800 and USP 795 requirements.

Protection & Compliance.OSHA: OSHA Standard -29 CRF, Safety and Health Regulations for General Industry, 1910.1450: Occupational exposure to hazardous chemicals in laboratories. Part B, definition, laboratory type hood. This product may assist you with compliance or as part of your chemical hygiene plan. Please consult your Safety Officer and/or Industrial Hygienist.
